statements.__comment: Reset exposed_internet properties on all OCI subnets in scope
statements.query: MATCH (n:OCISubnet)<-[:OCI_SUBNET]-(:OCIVcn)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE n.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE n.exposed_internet, n.exposed_internet_type, n.publicContext RETURN COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: Mark subnets as exposed if they allow public IPs on VNICs AND their OWN route table sends 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 to an internet gateway that is not known to be disabled (default_route_igw_ids, set at ingest). Route tables synced before that field existed fall back to the raw rule text naming an internet gateway.
statements.query: MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{prohibit_public_ip_on_vnic: false})<-[:OCI_SUBNET]-(:OCIVcn)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) MATCH (rt:OCIRouteTable{id: subnet.route_table_id}) UNWIND coalesce(rt.default_route_igw_ids, CASE WHEN rt.route_rules CONTAINS 'ocid1.internetgateway.' THEN [null] ELSE [] END) AS igw_id OPTIONAL MATCH (igw:OCIInternetGateway{id: igw_id}) WITH subnet, igw WHERE coalesce(igw.is_enabled, true) WITH DISTINCT subnet SET subnet.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'internet_gateway_route' IN coalesce(subnet.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN subnet END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(subnet.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'internet_gateway_route'

statements.__comment: Fail-safe: a subnet that allows public IPs but whose route table is not in the graph cannot be proven private, so it stays exposed as before
statements.query: MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet{prohibit_public_ip_on_vnic: false})<-[:OCI_SUBNET]-(:OCIVcn)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) OPTIONAL MATCH (rt:OCIRouteTable{id: subnet.route_table_id}) WITH subnet, rt WHERE rt IS NULL SET subnet.exposed_internet = true, (CASE WHEN NOT 'public_subnet_unresolved_route_table' IN coalesce(subnet.exposed_internet_type, []) THEN subnet END).exposed_internet_type = coalesce(subnet.exposed_internet_type, []) + 'public_subnet_unresolved_route_table'

statements.__comment: Build publicContext JSON for exposed subnets
statements.query: MATCH (subnet:OCISubnet)<-[:OCI_SUBNET]-(vcn:OCIVcn)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:OCICompartment{id: $OCI_COMPARTMENT_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:OCITenancy{id: $OCI_TENANCY_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE subnet.exposed_internet = true OPTIONAL MATCH (rt:OCIRouteTable{id: subnet.route_table_id}) SET subnet.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: subnet.ocid, resourceType: 'oci-subnet', context: [{subnetId: subnet.ocid, subnetName: subnet.display_name, cidrBlock: subnet.cidr_block, vcnId: vcn.ocid, vcnName: vcn.display_name, prohibitPublicIp: subnet.prohibit_public_ip_on_vnic, routeTableId: subnet.route_table_id, internetGateways: coalesce(rt.default_route_igw_ids, []), exposureTypes: subnet.exposed_internet_type, region: subnet.region}]}])
